body_text:
The Kuratowski encoding satisfies the defining property of an
ordered pair: $\langle x,y\rangle=\langle u,v\rangle$ if and only
if $x=u$ and $y=v$. The particular set-theoretic encoding is not
mathematically canonical; its purpose is to realize an abstract
two-slot object using sets while preserving equality of
coordinates.
